note: Flow's team pages, included by index.screen.json: the inbox of notifications, the cycles with their burn-up, and the projects. The sidebar and the G chords switch between them and the issues.

computed.roadmapTracks: {{map(data.projects, { id: '' + index, label: it.name, clips: [{ id: '' + index, label: it.name, start: max(0, daysBetween(state.roadmapStart, it.start ?? it.target)), duration: max(1, daysBetween(it.start ?? it.target, it.target)), color: it.color + '38' }] })}}

openProjectPage.note: with: at, the project's index: its own page, with its properties, milestones and updates

postProjectUpdate.note: with: at, health and text. A project update, newest first, from the person; the project takes the update's health

fields.updates: {{concat([{ who: state.me, health: health, when: state.today, text: trim(text) }], data.projects[at].updates ?? [])}}

submitProjectUpdate.note: the project page's composer: posts what is typed with the health picked, then clears it

toggleMilestone.note: with: k, a milestone of the open project: done, or not done again

addMilestone.note: a milestone named as typed, due on the open project's target date

fields.milestones: {{concat(computed.project.milestones ?? [], [{ name: trim(state.milestoneDraft), target: computed.project.target ?? state.today, done: false }])}}

changeRoadmapClip.note: a project's bar moved or trimmed on the roadmap: its start and target dates follow

project.description: The project's name, like Label palette

health.description: on track, at risk, off track or completed

text.description: What changed, in a sentence or two

do.note: an update on the project with that name, in any case; a project or a health that isn't there changes nothing, and the notice says so

openProject.note: with: at, the project's index: its issues, behind a Project filter whose chip removes it

pickNotification.note: with: at, the notification's place among the shown ones; marks it read

pageHeader.note: A page's top bar: an icon, a title and room for buttons on the end side

progressBar.note: A thin bar filled to a ratio from 0 to 1

cycleStat.note: One figure of the current cycle: a caption over a number

inboxPage.note: The notifications on the start side, the one picked on the end side with its issue

children.label: {{n.ref}} {{find(computed.allCards, it.ref == n.ref).title ?? ''}}: {{t('inbox.' + n.kind, { who: find(state.members, it.who == n.who).name ?? n.who, to: n.to ?? '' })}}

children.text: {{t('inbox.' + n.kind, { who: find(state.members, it.who == n.who).name ?? n.who, to: n.to ?? '' })}}
{{t('inbox.' + computed.notification.kind, { who: find(state.members, it.who == computed.notification.who).name ?? computed.notification.who, to: computed.notification.to ?? '' })}}

cyclesPage.note: The current cycle with its burn-up (scope and completed points), then the upcoming and past cycles

projectsPage.note: The projects as a table or on a roadmap, and a project's own page with its milestones and updates
